headline.en: Remove selected transcript turns with a visible diff.
headline.zh: 带着可见差异移除选定会话轮次。

sub.en: Excise lists and edits supported coding-agent transcripts, preserving stable turn IDs and tool-call relationships while exposing the proposed cut before writing.
sub.zh: Excise 列出并编辑已支持的编码会话，保留稳定轮次 ID 与工具调用关系，写入前展示待删除内容。

body.en: Select a range instead of discarding the entire session.
body.zh: 按范围选择，无需丢弃整个会话。

body.en: Dry-run shows the proposed transcript diff.
body.zh: dry-run 展示待应用的会话差异。

body.en: Existing write targets get a compressed snapshot.
body.zh: 修改已有目标前生成压缩快照。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Python 3 drives a dry-run cut of turn 5 in the included transcript and verifies its SHA256 is unchanged.
note.zh: Python 3 驱动对随仓会话第 5 轮的 dry-run 删除，并核实 SHA256 未变化。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/excise.git
cd excise
go build ./cmd/excise

limitations.en: The demo is dry-run only and confirms the original bytes stay unchanged. It does not test a running agent reloading the file.
limitations.zh: 示例仅 dry-run，并确认源字节不变；不测试运行中的 Agent 重新加载文件。

limitations.en: Cursor SQLite editing writes a .excised.jsonl sidecar rather than changing the live database. The first sidecar has no previous version to restore.
limitations.zh: Cursor SQLite 编辑生成 .excised.jsonl 旁路文件，不修改在线数据库；首次生成的旁路文件没有旧版本可恢复。

limitations.en: Model reranking is opt-in and can send transcript excerpts to the configured endpoint. Heuristic suggestions are review candidates, not proof that a turn is useless.
limitations.zh: 模型重排需主动开启，可能向所配端点发送会话片段。启发式建议只是待检查候选，不证明某轮无用。

body.en: A failed detour can consume context while the rest of a session remains useful. Select the specific turns, inspect dependency warnings and retain a snapshot when changing an existing supported transcript.
body.zh: 失败的支线可能占用上下文，而其余会话仍然有用。可以选定具体轮次、检查依赖警告，并在修改已有支持格式文件时保留快照。

body.en: Format loaders produce a shared turn model. Heuristics rank removal candidates; optional model reranking refines the shortlist. The dependency graph checks selected turns, the TUI or cut command presents a diff, and writers apply changes with snapshot and edit-log support.
body.zh: 格式加载器生成共享轮次模型；启发式规则推荐候选，可选模型重排进一步排序。依赖图检查选定轮次，TUI 或 cut 命令展示差异，writer 在快照与编辑日志支持下应用修改。

body.en: Format loaders produce a shared turn model. Heuristics rank removal candidates; optional model reranking refines the shortlist. The dependency graph checks selected turns, the TUI or cut command presents a diff, and writers apply changes with snapshot and edit-log support.
body.zh: 格式加载器生成共享轮次模型；启发式规则推荐候选，可选模型重排进一步排序。依赖图检查选定轮次，TUI 或 cut 命令展示差异，writer 在快照与编辑日志支持下应用修改。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: Sessions whose bubbles carry no timestamp field now keep their on-disk order instead of being shuffled into UUID order, writes and rollback preserve the file mode instead of silently tightening it to 0600, the default Cursor path probes the documented Windows location, and the edit log records the full dependency closure of every cut.
body.zh: 无时间戳字段的会话轮次不再被乱序重排，写入与回滚保留文件权限位不再悄悄收紧为 0600，默认 Cursor 路径补上文档承诺的 Windows 位置，编辑审计日志记录每次裁剪的完整依赖闭包。

body.en: --tool selects auto, claude or cursor. cut uses 1-based ranges such as 5-7,9; --dry-run prints the diff, --yes accepts a real write, and --force overrides dependency warnings. Snapshots live in ~/.excise and are pruned after 30 days on a later snapshot write. rollback --list lists IDs; rollback ID --to path selects a destination explicitly. Optional excise.toml is loaded from the project or XDG config, with [llm] backend, model, host, top_n, timeout_sec, provider and api_key_env.
body.zh: --tool 可选 auto、claude、cursor。cut 使用从 1 开始的 5-7,9 等范围；--dry-run 展示差异，--yes 确认真实写入，--force 跳过依赖警告。快照放在 ~/.excise，后续写快照时清理超过 30 天的旧项。rollback --list 列出 ID，rollback ID --to path 显式指定恢复目标。可选 excise.toml 从项目或 XDG 配置加载，[llm] 支持 backend、model、host、top_n、timeout_sec、provider 与 api_key_env。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/excise list testdata/claude_session_simple.jsonl
go run ./cmd/excise suggest testdata/claude_session_polluted.jsonl --json
go run ./cmd/excise cut 5 testdata/claude_session_simple.jsonl --dry-run
# Interactive review of your own file:
go run ./cmd/excise pick session.jsonl
